channel.title: Off the Clock · Aditya Mate
channel.description: My non-technical, non-serious corner of the internet: curious stories, armchair thoughts, travel accounts, and the odd page from my diary.

item.title: Cricket Camaraderie in Houston
item.description: The tournament ran Saturday to Tuesday, but our team was so sure we'd crash out in the group stages that most of us booked return tickets for Monday. Let me explain why.

item.title: First Taste of Harvard Business School
item.description: My first B-school class ever, a negotiation course at HBS, and a pleasant surprise about what actually goes on inside those revered classrooms.

item.title: Weekend at Forest Trails, Pune
item.description: If I were John Keats writing my own Ode on a Grecian Urn, I'd freeze time at 12:30 pm last Sunday.

item.title: Undergrad Internship at Sony, Japan
item.description: Even the toilet seat in Japan feels like an airplane cockpit, with its own dashboard of buttons, adjustable jets, seat heating and a built-in music system.
